# loams-starter

> A Mastra (TypeScript agent framework) project whose storage, memory and vectors live in
> Loams Postgres, a self-hosted Postgres with pgvector from the Loams data platform. It uses
> Mastra's own @mastra/pg package, unchanged.

## Where Loams runs

- Loams is self-hosted. It runs on the developer's machine (loopback, 127.0.0.1) or on a server
  reached over a tailnet (Tailscale or Headscale). Never point this project at a public
  endpoint, and never expose Loams to the internet.
- Local Loams Postgres: the release's loams-compose-<version>.tar.gz, directory
  loams-postgres-dev, `docker compose up -d`; it listens on 127.0.0.1:55433.
- Optional: `loams dev` serves a Qdrant-compatible vector API on 127.0.0.1:6333 (use
  @mastra/qdrant with apiKey = an lk_ key and the header Loams-Namespace).

## Environment

- DATABASE_URL: the Loams Postgres connection string (required).
- MODEL: a Mastra model-router id for the agent, for example openai/gpt-5-mini.
- Provider keys (for example OPENAI_API_KEY) for real models.
- LOAMS_API_KEY, LOAMS_NAMESPACE, LOAMS_QDRANT_URL: only with the Qdrant gateway.

## Code

- src/mastra/storage.ts: PostgresStore, PgVector, the model and the embedder.
- src/mastra/agents/assistant.ts: the agent with Memory (lastMessages, semanticRecall).
- src/mastra/tools/search-docs.ts: RAG over PgVector.
- src/mastra/workflows/ingest-docs.ts: chunk, embed, upsert.
